items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Dr. Charlie, $50 give me one treatment

ctx.x: Dr. Charlie, $50 give me one treatment, you know, I must have been pretty sick. I don't worry about my $50, plus $10 for the medicine. Mmm. Ooh.
Let me ask you some more questions about your life. Alright. Where were you born?
